items.title: The presheaf of sections of a pullback of a quasi-coherent sheaf satisfies the fpqc sheaf condition
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter etale-cohomology.tex, section on descent of quasi-coherent sheaves
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The proposition states that for a quasi-coherent sheaf F on S the presheaf F^a : (T -> S) -> Gamma(T, f^*F) on the category of schemes over S is an O-module satisfying the sheaf condition for the fpqc topology (statement lines 1333-1341). The work is to translate a sheaf-theoretic condition into algebra: after reducing to Zariski coverings and faithfully flat affine morphisms, the affine case is exactly the exactness of 0 -> M -> B tensor_A M -> B tensor_A B tensor_A M for a faithfully flat A -> B, which is the descent lemma for modules, and the Zariski case collapses because pullback along an open immersion has the same sections (proof lines 1350-1365). The reduction step and the identification of the Amitsur complex with the sheaf condition are what make the proposition non-immediate. The claim is H2.
